body:
The previous code caused the main window not to receive `_NET_WM_STATE_FOCUSED` on i3wm when the dialog was closed. i3 seems to update `_NET_WM_STATE_FOCUSED` only when the focus changes. Actively requesting updates seems to break the update conditions in i3. I'm not sure if this is a bug in i3.

https://github.com/i3/i3/blob/f231b3840dde78583a30c284d5ddba44fb813331/src/x.c#L1404

https://github.com/i3/i3/blob/f231b3840dde78583a30c284d5ddba44fb813331/src/x.c#L108-L110

https://x.org/releases/X11R7.6/doc/xorg-docs/specs/ICCCM/icccm.html#input_focus

Godot doesn't seem to use any of the four models of input handling.
Relevant window events will still be received even when the window is being destroyed. Ignore them.
In case the window manager doesn't support `_NET_WM_STATE_FOCUSED`.
